current.text: He is projected as Portland's starting center, with about 28 minutes per night in a role like last season's.
Experts expect no cut in his minutes, but also no move above 28 minutes. One projection puts his usage at 17%.
Portland has many centers. Robert Williams outplayed him in the playoffs, and he played poorly there.
Portland is crowded with high-usage guards: Lillard, Morant, Holiday and Henderson, plus Avdija. The team wants its bigs to stay out of the paint so the drivers have room.
Experts do not expect a big leap this season because the roster fit is crowded.
Portland has a new head coach this season.

The experts agree that his Yahoo price (rank around 38 to 44, round three) is far too early. One says he would not take him anywhere from round two to round five. Another calls the Yahoo rank a nonsense category-league rank.
The newest expert call puts his fair value around rank 60 to 70. One earlier projection was lower, at 75 to 95, with an auction price of about 5 USD.
At ESPN's late price (ADP around 100 to 109), experts call him good value.
He climbs to 14th in punt FT% rankings, but that is still no reason to reach for him in round three.
Portland has three back-to-backs in the fantasy playoffs. It also has a five-game week starting February 8.

durable.text: He is one of the best rebounders in the league and a very good shot blocker. Those are his only strong categories.
Experts call him a poor finisher with bad hands. His FG% is below par for a center, and he cannot post up.
He is a bad free throw shooter. Experts call his FT% terrible.
He takes threes and makes about one per game, but he scores little and gets few assists or steals.
He had knee and ankle problems in his first two NBA seasons.

note: Clingan helps in two categories, rebounds and blocks. He gives back some FT% and is below average in steals, assists and points. That makes him a center to fill out a build, not a core pick. Yahoo prices him at 16.2 USD (rank 44), while ESPN (7.0 USD) and our league's last auction (7 USD) are much closer to the experts' fair value around rank 60 to 70, so bid near 7 to 10 USD and let someone else pay Yahoo's price. Early in the season, check whether he stays near 28 minutes in a crowded center room under a new coach, and whether his threes hold up.
